liveness.rule: live = the ticket was saved before the draw's sales close (src/drawClose.json): stamped (madeAt) before it and committed as stamped, or committed before it; recovered = rewritten after the draw - the live record scores the ticket that stood at the close; back-built or late = no version before the close, or the row added after it; a second row of one name on a draw is not live (duplicate row)
